title: Of course! Here's the brief description of the bikes
subtitle: Ducati
description_it:
Cagiva Mito 125: A lightweight 2-stroke sportbike, iconic for its Ducati 916-inspired design. Though only 125cc, it delivers impressive agility and performance, making it a legend among young riders and collectors.
Yamaha R3: A 321cc 4-stroke parallel-twin sportbike that's beginner-friendly yet sporty. It offers a solid mix of reliability, responsive handling, and a sleek, modern look—ideal for riders entering the supersport world.
Kawasaki Ninja 500 SE: The evolution of the Ninja 400, with a 451cc twin-cylinder engine…
